card.title: Outsmart the Room
card.instruction: Turn every clue, deduction, and secret into a contest you must solve or control first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my conclusion above yours on the board.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then chronology decides who outsmarted whom.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My chalk reached the board first.

mechanism: A changes the measure of intellectual victory from conclusion to timing to chalk contact to avoid sharing a tie.
confusable: Unlike wanting recognition of a real unique contribution, A must turn equivalent work into winning over B.
comparison: A chalkboard tie leads to a physical priority claim, unlike the biscuit search extending what counts as solved.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
